MaxLossAmountDesc: Maximum loss since strategy start. Uses the ClosedPnL + OpenPnL delta, so floating loss is included.
MaxConsecutiveLossesDesc: Maximum consecutive losing ClosedPnL updates before the blocker triggers.
EnableWindowsShutdownDesc: Default on. When enabled, hitting a risk limit forces Windows shutdown for a cooldown break.
BlockerSubtitle: Trading is paused. Review your risk plan before continuing.
